implementation_contract.retention: Reads suppress receipts older than the configured day window without mutation. Successful appends prune expired receipts from the audit envelope only before enforcing bounds and rotation, and reject an already expired new receipt before mutation. Status updates use their newly written updated_at as audit recorded_at rather than the original message stored_at.
implementation_contract.bounds_and_rotation: Each generation is bounded independently by both record count and its compact serialized UTF-8 byte size. The envelope contains at most two generations and fixed schema overhead. When adding a valid receipt would exceed either current-generation bound, atomically replace previous with the old current and start current with the new receipt. If the single new entry cannot fit, leave the existing audit file unchanged.
implementation_contract.atomicity: Serialize to a unique sibling temporary file, flush and fsync it, replace with os.replace, and remove temporary residue on every failure. A module-level path-keyed shared reentrant lock prevents lost updates across TelegramInboxStore instances in this process; no cross-process serialization guarantee is claimed.
implementation_contract.fail_closed: Missing audit file may be initialized by a valid append. Corrupt JSON, schema-invalid envelopes, invalid entries, read I/O errors and write/replace errors make the audit store unavailable: read empty, write no-op, and never repair, truncate, delete or overwrite the suspect file.
implementation_contract.privacy: Only receipts freshly produced by project_telegram_audit_record with its exact closed field set and value types may be persisted. scope_ref must be empty or the existing chat_<12 lowercase hex> handle and is never returned by audit_history.
